intro.title: Welcome to TryCast
intro.body: You predict the competition's matches, and so do your mates. Every good call moves you up the table.

predictions.title: A prediction is a score
predictions.body: Call the exact score of the match. Your entry saves itself and locks at kick-off.
predictions.bonus: Tick the attacking bonus if a team scores 4 tries or more. Get it right and it pays. Get it wrong and you lose 10 points.
predictions.joker: A match looks like a sure thing? Play your double points. 1 per phase, it doubles all the points of the match.

leagues.title: Play with your mates
leagues.body: Create yours and share its code, or join your mates'. You can also play without a league: your points still count overall.

notifications.title: Never miss a kick-off
notifications.body: We remind you before each match, and let you know as soon as your points are in.
